author: Camostealth
body: I deeply apologize for my vulgarity and making a real bad image of myself quite awhile ago and I was perma-banned. I don't think that deserved a lifetime ban for foul language and disrespect. I will tell you I was caught up with the wrong crowd at the time and was pushed into the vulgarity by a friend, trying to defend her. I apologize for my actions long ago and wish to see that I have changed and would like to regain access to your server once again. Most apologies, Camostealth (nexus237 or Camo96 at the time).
